proof.text: Take the normalized ordinary scalar tensor comparison. The inverse comparisons in all bidegrees give tensorPullbackTotal. Its two differential identities follow by naturality, and scalar additivity preserves the signed differential. A left adjoint preserves the total coproducts, so this chain map is invertible. Its inverse sends scalar-unit pure summands to the indicated total pure summands.

proof.text: Use all K-flat complexes as representatives. Scalar extension preserves them; the universal scalar comparison computes on them and their total tensors. Its defining square is exactly ScalarHomTensorNormalization.
